data.long_description:
Experience refined luxury in this brand-new, vacant 4-bedroom standalone villa located in the prestigious Sobha Hartland community, Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Designed with elegance and functionality in mind, this exceptional residence offers spacious interiors, premium finishes, and outstanding privacy.

The villa features a private elevator providing seamless access across all floors, expansive living and dining areas, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a modern fully fitted kitchen. Each bedroom is generously sized with built-in wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms, while the master suite offers a luxurious retreat with ample storage and premium fixtures.

Step outside to your private landscaped garden and swimming pool, creating the perfect setting for relaxation, family gatherings, and entertaining guests.
